turns.question: What was our refund rate by value on the orders placed on 1 and 2 October 2026?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no refund-rate-by-value metric, so I can't give that figure. The closest is Return rate, which is a share of orders by count rather than by value: it was 0.1 (10%) for orders placed on 1 and 2 October 2026. Fresh: returns.silver is ready up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
